_instructions: Fee schedules used by the signal engine. Signals ABSTAIN (FEE_SCHEDULE_UNVERIFIED) unless the applicable schedule has verified=true. To verify: open the official PDF at source_url, confirm taker_rate, maker multipliers, formula and rounding match, then set verified=true and fill verified_by / verified_at (YYYY-MM-DD). If the PDF differs, add a NEW entry with a new version (never edit a verified entry in place; past signals reference versions).

schedules.formula: fee = taker_rate * C * P * (1 - P)  (C = contracts, P = price in dollars)

verified_from_docs: fee_type values and maker multipliers 0.25 / 0.5 (api-reference get-series, fee_type field, read 2026-11-18)
trade fee = model fee rounded UP to $0.000001 per fill; non-direct member balances aligned to $0.01 via a rounding fee (getting_started/fee_rounding, read 2026-11-18)
NOT_verified: taker_rate 0.07 and the C*P*(1-P) formula: from prior knowledge; the official PDF could not be fetched (HTTP 429). Confirm before setting verified=true.
how fee_multiplier is applied: not documented; the engine abstains when fee_multiplier != 1

schedules.formula: taker fee = round up(M x 0.07 x C x P x (1 - P)); maker fee = round up(M x 0.0175 x C x P x (1 - P))
schedules.verified_by: Official PDF supplied by the user; values checked by Claude

provenance.document: Kalshi fee schedule PDF, 'Last updated and effective: July 7, 2026'
verified_from_pdf: Taker: fees = round up(M x 0.07 x C x P x (1-P)), M default 1
Maker: fees = round up(M x 0.0175 x C x P x (1-P)), M default 0 unless indicated (0.0175 = 0.25 x 0.07; KXMVE maker M=2 -> 0.035 = 0.5 x 0.07)
KXCPI and KXCPIYOY: maker multiplier 1, taker multiplier 1
General Trading Fees Table (1 and 100 contracts, $0.01-$0.99) reproduced exactly by this model (see tests/test_fee_schedule_pdf.py)
provenance.rounding_note: PDF rounds fee + position cost up to a centicent ($0.0001); Kalshi docs (fee_rounding) align NON-direct member balances to $0.01, and the PDF's own table shows cent-rounded fees. balance_precision 0.01 is used for a retail account (conservative: overstates fees by < $0.01 per order vs centicent).
provenance.still_conservative: Engine assumes taker fees for every simulated fill and abstains when a market's fee_multiplier != 1 (API fee_multiplier vs separate maker/taker multipliers not mapped one-to-one).
